turns.prompt: kinetics.txt is a Gen5 kinetic export (absorbance at 405 nm every 30 s for 70 min). For wells A1 to A4, report the initial rate in OD/min from a straight-line fit to the reads from 0 to 5 minutes inclusive (key 'initial_rate'), and the first read time in minutes at which each well's OD exceeds 1.0 (key 'time_to_od1', null if it never does).

provenance: mimic of a BioTek Gen5 kinetic text export, s2.gen5
